prompt: Tom's plan to 'get a portfolio ready in six weeks' lists only outcomes: 'have a website, have three projects, be ready to apply.' Week three arrives and nothing is finished. What is the main flaw?

options.text: Six weeks is too long a deadline to motivate anyone
Portfolios cannot be planned in advance at all
He should have listed ten outcomes instead of three
The plan names results but no scheduled actions, order, or dependencies, so there is nothing specific to do on any given day

explanation: Outcomes cannot be done directly; actions can. A workable plan converts each outcome into dated steps and notes what must come first, such as choosing projects before building the site around them.
